en.headline: Taxi driver trapped after hitting works vehicle near Kowloon Station
en.dek: An empty taxi struck the rear of a parked cherry-picker on Austin Road West shortly after midnight; the 60-year-old driver was freed with minor injuries and sent to hospital.
body: A taxi driver was trapped inside his cab after the empty vehicle hit a parked works truck near Elements mall above Kowloon Station shortly after midnight on Friday, police and local reports said.

The taxi had come off Route 3 and was travelling along the Austin Road West flyover towards the W Hong Kong hotel when it struck the rear of a vehicle fitted with an elevated work platform, according to accounts carried by Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao Daily. The front of the taxi was badly damaged and the airbags deployed. The 60-year-old driver suffered minor injuries to his limbs and chest, remained conscious and was cut free before being taken by ambulance to Kwong Wah Hospital.
The 27-year-old driver of the works vehicle was unhurt. Reports said two workers on the truck were also uninjured. Police said they were investigating the cause of the collision.

The works vehicle had been parked at the scene so that crews could take down Belt and Road Summit banners from lamp posts and put up National Day decorations, the reports said. The changeover had not started when the taxi hit the truck.

zh.headline: 九龍站圓方對開的士撞工程車 60歲司機一度被困
zh.dek: 空載的士周五凌晨在雅翔道天橋撞向停泊工程車車尾，的士車頭嚴重損毀，司機清醒送廣華醫院，工程車司機及工人無羞。
body: 周五凌晨零時許，一輛空載的士在西九龍九龍站上蓋圓方商場對開的雅翔道天橋，撞向一輛停泊路邊、裝有升降工作台的工程車車尾，的士司機一度被困車內。
據《香港01》及《星島日報》報道，的士由三號幹線駛出，沿雅翔道往W酒店方向行駛時懷疑收揯不及。的士車頭嚴重損毀，氣袋彈出。60歲的士司機手腳及胸口受輕傷，保持清醒，由救援人員救出後由救護車送往廣華醫院治理。
27歲工程車司機沒有受傷，報道指車上工人亦無羞。警方正調查意外原因。
現場消息指，工程車當時停在該處，工人準備拆除燈柱上一帶一路高峰論壇直幡，換上國慶標語，工程尚未展開即遭後方的士撞及。
